title: Document Family Layout Recipe v1
description: Product policy, not a reference observation. A family recipe owns only what is true for every document of the family regardless of institution and regardless of document: page invariants, the native page count, and component-to-style-role bindings. It never declares a required document composition — which components a document uses, in what order, and whether it uses any of them is owned by the document's TemplateSpec.

native_page_count.description: Required: DOCUMENT_RENDER reads this from the approved package's recipe snapshot to enforce the family's native page contract, so it may not be optional.

page.description: Family-wide page invariants, enforced by resolve(). Top/bottom margins are deliberately absent: the layout baseline records them as VARIABLE across the reference documents, so they are a TemplateSpec decision.

component_defaults.description: component type -> Institution Design style/table role binding. This is NOT a family composition and NOT a required-component list: a key here only states which style role a component uses when a TemplateSpec does not override it. A TemplateSpec may use none, some, or all of these components in any order.
